'''Morgan Dunn Hunt Down for a Second''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Morgan Dunn]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-6110">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6110 Hunt Down for a Second], DeckTech (Morgan "jamorg247" Dunn, 29 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6110/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6110/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018175042/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6110/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Morgan Dunn]]
* '''Published:''' 29 April 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Hunt Down for a Second''

== Original post ==

'''Hunt Down for a Second'''
* '''Author:''' Morgan "jamorg247" Dunn
* '''Published:''' April 29, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Non dueling hunt down deck.

=== Strategy ===

Basicaly get out a few good characters and play I have you now. And win real quick.
